messages.subject: Error in getNames(this) : unused argument(s) (NA)
parts:
Hi,
Suddenly I receive the following error when trying to extract
information (below is an example), though the same function worked
fine in a previous session. Any ideas why this happens?

> theta <- extractMatrix(cesN, units=units, field = "theta");
Error in getNames(this) : unused argument(s) (NA)

Thanks,
Christina

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error in getNames(this) : unused  argument(s) (NA)
parts:
Hi Christina.

I've seen a message like this before and if I remember correctly, it is
due to a clash with a function from another package.

Two things to try:

1. When reporting errors like this, please report the output of
'traceback()' and 'sessionInfo()'.

2. If you run this on a clean R session, do you still get the same error?
(i.e. only loading aroma.affymetrix and the commands to create your 'cesN'
object)

Cheers,
Mark
